name: ldr
description: Light-dependent resistor (LDR) sensor driver. Reads ambient light intensity via ADC. Polarity depends on wiring (LDR to VCC or GND).

constructor_params.name: attenuation
constructor_params.description: ADC attenuation (ESP32 only). ATTN_11DB = 0-3.6V input range.

properties.name: value
properties.description: Same as read() — current ADC value (0-4095)

example:
from machine import Pin, ADC
from ldr import LDR
from time import sleep_ms

ldr = LDR(pin=Pin(34), attenuation=ADC.ATTN_11DB)
while True:
    print(ldr.value)
    sleep_ms(500)
esp32_notes: value direction depends on wiring: LDR-to-GND → brighter = higher value; LDR-to-VCC → brighter = lower value
ADC2 channels unusable when Wi-Fi is active — prefer ADC1 (GPIO32-39)
ATTT_11DB allows reading up to ~3.6V — sufficient for most LDR divider circuits
hardware_notes: Voltage divider: LDR in series with 10kΩ resistor between 3.3V and GND, midpoint to ADC pin
Add 100nF cap across LDR for noise smoothing
differences_from_standard_mp: Standard ADC returns raw value. LDR is a thin wrapper with documented wiring patterns.
